result.summary: Found 1 visual layout issue where a restaurant title is unexpectedly clipped mid-character.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' is clipped mid-character on the letter 'n' (appearing as 'Tokumaru Rameı'), despite ample horizontal space between the title and the rating '4.8 (500+)'.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the title container's width or flex/constraint layout so the full text fits without premature clipping, and apply proper ellipsis truncation only if the text actually exceeds available space.
